initiative.title: Chart and rendering documentation
initiative.summary: Task-led pages for every registered view and an accurate rendering guide, authored as build-time MDX in the demo with on-demand live examples.
initiative.next_action: Superseded by living-product-docs. Ready to retire on Byron's approval; planning files are kept until then.

claims.statement: Plan a page for each chart type and the overall rendering system
Cover every registered view, including tables and supporting views (twenty today)
Separate current rendering behavior from planned deterministic rendering work
Docs build as static files and ship in the demo's existing GitHub Pages deployment
Pages are image-heavy, and adding a page or replacing a screenshot is routine prose work
Embed the actual interactive React workspace where possible, without inventing a standalone chart API
Small system a solo developer can maintain: no server, CMS, versions, translations, or playground
Prose and figures work on narrow screens; live workspaces only at 1024 CSS px and up

conflicts.summary: AGENTS.md says screenshots stay in tmp/ and are never committed; curated docs images are committed under apps/demo/public/docs/
AGENTS.md says tooltips open on hover and keyboard focus; docs/ui-defaults.md says pointer hover only
conflicts.resolution: pending human decision; docs controls use visible labels meanwhile

shape.appetite: One small MDX shell in the demo (research estimate 12-20 h including proof), then pages in groups
shape.problem: Three TSX guides cost ~940 lines; twenty registered types make every prose and screenshot edit code work
shape.recommended_shape: In-demo docs as build-time MDX with imported figures, Figure/FigurePair/LiveExample components, a typed catalogue checked against coverage.ts, and on-demand iframe embeds of /examples/<id>
success_moves: Port the three shipped guides instead of greenfielding
Keep one router and one deployment
Fix the deploy toolchain first, separately
Treat the iframe as a probe with a direct-mount fallback; links always remain

first_proof.decision_rule: Proceed when URLs, tests, focus, build-failure-on-missing-image, and width-gated live brush all pass; otherwise apply the Starlight triggers

history.change: Copied the ChatGPT Pro documentation-system research into docs/research/. Adopted its build-time MDX + on-demand iframe recommendation with Starlight fallback, but reframed the proof as a port of the three TSX guides that shipped after the research's inspected commit. Extended scope from eleven to twenty registered types, added a deploy-toolchain milestone, cut subpath-base support, and replaced the hand-kept example table with coverage.ts. Rewrote intent, shape, and plan; renumbered milestones (old M2/M3 are now M4-M6).
